title: Hesai JT128 model-specific parameters
description: Sensor-specific parameters for the Hesai JT128 LiDAR used by Nebula.

rotation_speed.title: Rotation speed (RPM)
rotation_speed.description: Spin rate of the motor. JT128 supports 600 RPM (10 Hz) and 1200 RPM (20 Hz).

min_range.title: Minimum range (m)
min_range.description: Minimum distance in meters. Points closer than this are filtered out. JT128 instrumented range is 0–60 m; practical min around 0.3–0.5 m.

max_range.title: Maximum range (m)
max_range.description: Maximum distance in meters. Points farther than this are filtered out. JT128 instrumented range is 0–60 m.

return_mode.title: Return mode
return_mode.description: JT128 supports single and dual return modes. These symbolic values must match the mapping you implement in the JT128 HW interface.

dual_return_distance_threshold.title: Dual return distance fusion threshold (m)
dual_return_distance_threshold.description: For multiple returns that are close together, points can be fused if they are below this distance threshold.
